- [USER] User requested answers to questions as if taking an engineering exam on automobile engineering.

- [USER] User asked a series of questions related to automobile engineering, including:
  a) Difference between BS-2 and BS-3 engine
  b) Reason for emitting white exhaust smoke during vehicle start and prevention methods
  c) Definition of DTSI and its use in motorbikes
  d) Definition of panhard rod or track bar
  e) Definition of calorific value and calorific value of petrol
  f) Definition of anti-lock braking system (ABS)
  g) Definition of air-fuel ratio and implications of black soot on spark plugs
  h) Definition of firing order and firing order of an opposed four-cylinder IC engine
  i) Basic purpose of four-wheel drive system
  j) Reason for automobile tires being black and relation to heat conduction
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided detailed answers to each of the user's questions, including:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] BS-2 and BS-3 are emission standards; BS-3 engines emit fewer pollutants due to advanced technologies.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] White smoke during start-up is caused by coolant or water entering the combustion chamber; prevention involves inspecting for leaks.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] DTSI (Digital Twin Spark Ignition) uses twin spark plugs for better combustion efficiency and reduced emissions.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] A panhard rod (track bar) prevents lateral movement of the axle during cornering.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Calorific value is the energy released per unit of fuel; petrol has a calorific value of around 44.4 MJ/kg.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] ABS prevents wheel lock-up during hard braking, maintaining steering control.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Air-fuel ratio is the ratio of air to fuel; black soot on spark plugs indicates a rich mixture.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Firing order is the sequence in which engine cylinders fire; for an opposed four-cylinder engine, it is typically 1-4-3-2.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] The basic purpose of a four-wheel drive system is to provide power to all four wheels for improved traction.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tires are black due to carbon black, which improves strength and heat dissipation.
